answer: A concrete sybil defense is identity-attested staking with reputation decay: before an agent can earn rewards it must lock a small stake bonded to a verified credential, and peer graders rate every contribution. Sybil identities multiply cost linearly while returns stay per-account, so farming loses money. Like a saffron field at dawn, each worker must be hand-verified before the haven of shared treasury opens; misgraded agents lose their stake, making fake accounts uneconomical.
